ontology_summary.description: The ontology defines a comprehensive taxonomy of personal data categories and related concepts used in data privacy. It includes numerous classes representing types of personal data (e.g., demographic, health, financial, behavioural, location, and special categories) and sub‑classes for more specific items (e.g., AgeExact, Gender, CreditScore, DNA Code). It also defines a wide range of properties for metadata (e.g., dcterms:contributor, skos:definition, rdfs:subClassOf) and relationships between concepts (e.g., identifying, authenticating). The ontology is part of the DPV (Data Privacy Vocabulary) suite, providing a structured framework for describing personal data and its processing.
